requirement.description: Multiple test failures related to pickle serialization of modules in CRC tests
requirement.contract: Fix the TypeError: cannot pickle 'module' object that occurs when running CRC tests that use multiprocessing. The issue occurs in the CRC library's concurrent processing functionality.

requirement.description: Simulator regression tests failing due to awaitable objects not being properly handled
requirement.contract: Fix TypeError: object Tick can't be used in 'await' expression and similar errors for various trigger types (Tick, Delay, PosEdgeTrigger) in simulator processes.

requirement.description: Domain lookup assertion failure in simulator integration tests
requirement.contract: Fix AssertionError: <amaranth.hdl._cd.ClockDomain object at 0x...> != <amaranth.hdl._cd.ClockDomain object at 0x...> in domain lookup functionality. The issue is with object identity comparison instead of logical equivalence.

requirement.description: Missing negedge attribute in PosEdgeTrigger object
requirement.contract: Ensure that PosEdgeTrigger and other trigger objects have proper negedge method implementation to support chained edge triggers like posedge().negedge().
Add the missing _init attribute to Slice class to prevent AttributeError when accessing it.
